properties.description: crates/reflow2-mcp/tests/a_topic_report_says_what_it_holds_and_what_it_did_not_find.rs (3 tests) on a small rainfall design: a subject comes back grouped (Requirement, Capability, …) with the capability's realized status, its SATISFIES-out and VERIFIES-in connections, and the newest DATED change as latest while an undated change is never offered and a dated measurement is the other side of latest; an unrelated node does not appear; the not-found line names a populated type that matched nothing (Contributor) and a zero-hit query says NOTHING MATCHED and that the subject may be held in other words; a 600-character budget lands in titles_only with connections and latest withheld, at least one hit per group kept, and count and by_type unchanged.
properties.findings: 3 tests (one of them now also pinning the limit-cut wording) passed; reflow2-mcp 384 / 0 and reflow2-core 1596 / 0 with the module in; clippy clean on both crates; toolsnap gained exactly one golden (topic_report). Read against reflow2's OWN design through the built binary on a copy of the store ("root cause", budget 8000): 20 hits across 8 of 19 populated types, titles-only tier, and the not-found line exposed a wording defect in itself — it reported 436 TemporalFacts as NOT matched when the list had merely been cut at 20. Fixed before shipping (a type absent from a list cut at its limit is "not among the top N") and pinned in the same test file.
properties.name: A topic report groups hits by type with status and connections, offers only the latest DATED change, always carries a not-found line, and trims detail before hits
